messages:
tyler: Quick heads-up — our preflight/roundtrip lint is now catching a nasty mismatch between the Console YAML editor and the route validation API. Repro below.
mira: ugh, saw a couple of alerts. editor's pretty aggressively reordering map keys when you edit headers. that breaks anchor-based header overrides.
jess: CI started failing on the route tests this morning (job #482). looks like the validator is stricter than the editor output :grimace:
alex: quick summary of cause: editor serializes maps with its own sort -> validator expects anchors/refs in original order for our legacy resolver. round-trip serialize(parse(yaml)) != originalYaml
tyler: repro steps I used:
```
# export file from console
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console/api/routes/123/export > route.yaml
# validate with server
curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/yaml" --data-binary @route.yaml https://api/internal/v1/routes/validate
```
mira: interesting edge: when header matcher is an array vs single string we also lose the original scalar->array shape. validator currently treats them as different.
alex: proposed fixes:
- make validator tolerant: accept scalar where array expected (normalize on parse)
- add a deterministic stableSort in the editor serializer for top-level maps (but keep a toggle off for backward-compat)
- add a roundtrip unit test: serialize->validate->deserialize->serialize should be idempotent
jess: can we add a lint rule instead? "roundtrip-idempotent" that flags changes when editor autosave alters semantics. then Console can show a yellow banner with an opt-in autofix.
tyler: love the lint rule idea. UI needs a suppression toggle (one-click) and a "why this changed" diff panel. UX: show before/after and allow apply/ignore.
alex: sketch of unit test in jest:
```
const a = fs.readFileSync('route.yaml', 'utf8')
const parsed = parser.parse(a)
const serialized = editor.serialize(parsed)
expect(parser.parse(serialized)).toEqual(parser.parse(a))
```
and a stricter check for stable serialization:
```
const s2 = editor.serialize(parser.parse(serialized))
expect(s2).toEqual(serialized)
```
mira: will add a small patch to editor serializer first to do stableSort for keys that affect matching logic (headers, matchers, priority). keep it behind a feature flag: editor.stableRoutingSerialize
ci-bot: CI: route-schema-roundtrip (job 482) — failure
  • 1 new lint error: roundtrip-idempotent: route.yaml changed after editor serialize
tyler: ok next steps:
- mira: PR to add stable serialize flag + unit tests (small, include example with anchored headers)
- alex: make validator normalize scalar/array for header fields and update schema docs
- jess: add lint rule and console banner UX mock
I'll open a tracking issue and add owners. ping me when PRs are ready so we can run the pipeline. :thumbsup:
